summary.text: Gina Hinojosa is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives from Austin (District 49) and an attorney who previously served on the Austin school board. She is running on public school funding, opposition to school vouchers, and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Born in McAllen and raised in Brownsville; B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin (1996) and J.D. from George Washington University (1999).
Began her career as a civil rights lawyer representing union members; served on the Austin Independent School District board 2012–2016.
Elected to the Texas House in 2016 and sworn in January 10, 2017; announced her run for governor on October 15, 2025.
